description: I101 rebased onto the current tip (its old base, E086, is superseded). Base: E090 code, which already has the samples-indexed _fit. Run the 16 and 24 px phases at bs 1024 instead of 1536, which adds ~53 steps. The 28/32 px phases and the whole tail stay as on the tip. LR warmup/decay, the floor-hold and the renorm cadence are indexed by samples. Scale the SGD groups per phase by the kilostep rule and leave Muon lr and momentum unchanged. Compile static bs-1024 16/24 px shapes, including the whitening-bias-grad variant at 16 px, and warm them up in build. Decide with an off-seed run on seeds 3-10 plus one scored run. Compare the gain per added step with E084 (+0.11 pp off-seed for ~65 tail steps).
